page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top, printed page number at top right. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Vide hic miserum naturalis hominis statu, Mens ejus ignoratione voluntatis [illegible, ~6 letters] est: voluntas a Diabolo captiva tenetur. Vide etiam Dei esse, dare resipiscentiam hominibus, adeoq; nō vulgare, sed singulare esse Dei donum. Efficit autem illam Deus per agnitionem veritatis, nempe coelestis, patefactæ verbo Dei, tum de cultu Dei, tum de salute nostra.

Qui enim ex verbo legis cognovit, Deum æternis suppliciis punire velle omnes in impietate perfistētes, ac tum ex verbo Evangelii, Deum in gratiam recipere velle omnes resipiscentes, & in Christum credentes, fieri nequit, quin per gratiam Dei resipiscat, & gratiam Dei fide apprehendens posthac pietati serio studeat. Dei interim est, per spiritum & verbum suum illuminare & convertere corda nostra.

Ergo si quæritur, quifiat, ut mortè æter-nam meriti peccatis nostris, nihilominus ab eâ liberati, ad vitam æternâ perveniamus? Christianum responsum est: quia supplici-um mortis æternæ, cujus judicio eam

page.notes: Top right corner shows a handwritten or stamped "300" that is not printed text; left out. The marginal fragment near "ob-"/"ibria" is damaged and illegible at the start of the line "est". The word "esse" is read from a worn "efse/effe" form. Catchword "pecca-" read from a faint impression. Signature "L 5" read from the foot of the page. The paragraph at the foot ends mid-sentence, continued on the next page. Ampersands kept as printed.
